items.reason: Each worker now has an unbounded Executor.Job.Queue overflow; a failed deque.push goes there. The run loop, stealing, the idle-wait check and the shutdown drain all consult it. Test: `more jobs than a worker deque holds all run` (1-worker pool blocked by a spinning job, 2048 jobs dealt, all must complete within a deadline). README law updated in c7bfc04ea29c75792a2349f6de0e5ffa4d75eaf6.

Chose idempotent everywhere: the preconditionFailure on a missing thread handle is now a plain return, which also makes Sharded.shutdown() idempotent. Tests `second shutdown does nothing` for Kernel.Thread.Executor, Sharded and Stealing. README updated.
